name: Sock Cactus — Rhythm Ritual
summary:
A sweet fusion of surrealism, Buddhism, and rhythm shooting.

Enter the zone and relive your life flashing before your eyes — on a roller coaster!

To the beat, capture the sock-fruits ripening on cacti with a dual-wielding, healing cyber-mokugyo (wooden fish)!

Peek at fragments of memory hidden inside each sock-fruit — and revisit the ones you've found in the encyclopedia!

VR trip packed with vaporwave, surrealism, Japanese local culture, and a homage to American Surrealism…
